immutability: Locked recovery points cannot be deleted or have retention shortened; naive attempts are blocked.
recovery_dependency: Recoverability depends on the recovery dependency graph. A recovery point restores only if every dependency it requires is intact. Operator-controlled dependencies can be changed by the operator; compliance-locked dependencies cannot.
operator_authority: The operator may run routine snapshots, policy-compliant retention changes, and DR tests. Defeating recoverability is not authorized.
responder_order: Preserve a viable immutable recovery point before relying on restore; prefer targeted containment (session revoke + lock) over estate-wide shutdown.
